description: This is a PHP source file defining the CKEditor PHPWrapper class used for integrating CKEditor into PHP applications. It provides methods to create and manage rich text editor instances, handle configuration, and manage events.

classes.name: CKEditor
classes.description: A PHP class to create and configure CKEditor instances within PHP web pages, supporting options for configuration, event handling, and script rendering.

methods.name: editor
methods.description: Creates a CKEditor instance with specified name, initial value, configuration, and event handlers.

methods.name: replace
methods.description: Replaces a specified textarea element with a CKEditor instance, optionally with custom configuration and events.

methods.name: replaceAll
methods.description: Replaces all textarea elements, or those with a specific class, with CKEditor instances.

methods.name: addEventHandler
methods.description: Adds a JavaScript event handler for CKEditor events on specific editor instances.

methods.name: clearEventHandlers
methods.description: Clears all event handlers for CKEditor instances, or for a specific event.

methods.name: addGlobalEventHandler
methods.description: Adds a global event handler for CKEditor events.

methods.name: clearGlobalEventHandlers
methods.description: Clears all global CKEditor event handlers.
